Delhi Steps Up Security for Independence Day Celebrations

Delhi Police have issued advisories regarding road closures from August 13-15 and increased security measures around the Red Fort for Independence Day. Approximately 20,000 security personnel are to be deployed, supported by CCTV surveillance and anti-drone technology. Posters of 19 wanted terrorists have been displayed across the city as part of heightened vigilance. The Indian Army conducted a 21-gun salute rehearsal near the Red Fort.
